currentGoal: Start fleshing out automation directions 1 and 2: a clearer Automation Manager panel and better helper role/lane presentation.
workCompleted: Expanded the existing Automation panel into an Automation Manager instead of adding a separate overlay.
Added manager summary lines for active automation units, total automation output, current lane, output multiplier, helper tempo, automated touches, supplies, and best automation streak.
Added a best-next-buy nudge that scans unlocked automation routes and recommends the strongest next single-unit purchase by output-per-cost, or the closest unaffordable route if none can be bought.
Added a top-route contribution line showing the largest automation route contributors and their approximate share of total automation output.
Added a synergy line that lists active named ecosystem synergies, with compact mobile trimming.

Each lane row now shows live effect text from directive tuning, including output multiplier, helper tempo, regrow help, supply chance, helper touch multiplier/bonus, and Auto-Pilot's current resolved lane.
Kept automation output math, helper intervals, quests, scheduler behavior, and tile hot paths unchanged.
